title: 第10章 回城邑
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“嗯，我已经打通任督二脉，入了地境。”

祁澜的目光中带着几分喜悦。

一朝突破，他自然高兴。

光论武道实力，他放在蜀地，也是一号人物了。

”恭喜少君，贺喜少君，可要即刻去信回长溪邑，告知主君？还是我等即刻返回？“

祁平一下子兴奋了起来。

对绝大部分的侯伯来说，部族里增加一个地境武士都不是小事。

而对长溪部来说，祁澜成为地境武士，不仅代表部族的高端战力大幅度增强，也代表着传承的真正稳固。

毕竟，他是长溪子爵的世子，邦国的储君，第一继承人。

”可修书一封发回去，至于我等倒是不着急，此番在灌江口置购了不少屋子，车马劳顿，此时外面下雨，道路泥泞，也不便赶路，不妨等雨停了再说。“

“属下明白。“”

“另外，让庖厨备下吃食，今日本世子武道精进，府中上下，当食大宴，皆有酒肉！”

“平这就去唤人准备！”

不多时，厅堂内，祁澜面前便摆上了一大桌食物，其他人，也都备上了酒菜。

那些随行的官员和武士，也都在堂内两侧的席位上用席。

当然，他们吃的没祁澜那么多。

光是麦饭、黍米就分别摆了一大盆，其他的兽肉、禽肉、果蔬，也摆满了桌面。

庖厨是按照部族里其他地境武士的标准为他备餐的。

地境武者，若是放开了吃，可日啖一牛，尤其在征伐出手后，气血消耗较大，需要补充的时候，那就更多了。

祁澜之前为了调整身体状态，断食半日，上午又只服用了赤脉草和少许汤药。

虽然灵草药力强劲，化作气血补充，但消耗也很大，加上刚刚突破，正是需要大量食物，炼为气血，夯实根基，稳固境界。

不过两刻钟，桌上的食物就被一扫而空。

到了地境，气血凝练，运转周天，可催发五脏六腑，催谷脾胃、分解肉食五谷，就如熔炉一般，顷刻间便能将粮肉熔炼为精气。

等到宴席结束，祁澜也吃完了那一桌子的饭菜，又喝了两碗热汤，这才拍着肚子往院里的走廊下走了一圈。

刚破地境的身体还在适应新的气血运转节奏，五脏六腑像被炭火慢慢烘过一遍，飞快地消化着刚才被吃掉的食物，化作精纯气血，冲刷己身。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Well, I have opened up the Rendu and Du meridian and entered the earth realm."

There was a bit of joy in Qi Lan's eyes.

Once he breaks through, he will naturally be happy.

In terms of martial arts prowess alone, he would be the number one figure in Shu.

"Congratulations, young master. Congratulations, young master. Do you want to write back to Changxi immediately and inform the master? Or should we return immediately?"

Qi Ping suddenly became excited.

For most Hou Bo, adding an Earth warrior to the tribe is no small matter.

For the Changxi Tribe, Qi Lan's becoming an Earth Warrior not only represents a significant increase in the tribe's high-end combat power, but also represents the true stability of the inheritance.

After all, he is the eldest son of Viscount Changxi, the prince of the country, and the first heir.

"You can send back a copy of the repair letter. As for us, we are not in a hurry. We have purchased a lot of houses in Guanjiangkou this time, and we are tired of traveling. It is raining outside and the roads are muddy, so it is inconvenient to travel. We might as well wait until the rain stops."

"My subordinates understand."

"In addition, let the chef prepare some food. Today, my prince's martial arts has improved, and there will be a feast with wine and meat in the house!"

"Ping, go call someone to prepare now!"

Not long after, a large table of food was placed in front of Qi Lan in the hall, and everyone else also prepared wine and food.

The accompanying officials and warriors also took seats on both sides of the hall.

Of course, they didn't eat as much as Qi Lan.

There were large bowls of wheat rice and millet rice, and other animal meat, poultry meat, fruits and vegetables were also placed on the table.

The chef prepared meals for him according to the standards of other land warriors in the tribe.

If an Earth Realm warrior lets go and eats, he can eat an ox a day, especially after the conquest, when the energy and blood are consumed a lot and need to be replenished, it will be even more.

In order to adjust his physical condition, Qi Lan fasted for half a day, and in the morning he only took red vein grass and a little decoction.

Although the spiritual herbs are powerful and can be turned into qi and blood to replenish the body, it consumes a lot of money. In addition, since the breakthrough has just been made, a large amount of food is needed to refine the qi and blood, consolidate the foundation, and stabilize the realm.

Within two quarters of an hour, the food on the table was cleared.

At the ground level, Qi and blood are condensed and circulate around the sky, which can stimulate the internal organs, stimulate the spleen and stomach, and decompose meat and grains. Just like a furnace, the grains and meat can be smelted into essence in an instant.

When the banquet was over, Qi Lan also finished the food on the table and drank two bowls of hot soup before patting his belly and walking down the corridor in the courtyard.

The body that had just broken through the realm was still adapting to the new rhythm of qi and blood circulation. The internal organs seemed to be slowly roasted by charcoal fire, quickly digesting the food that had just been eaten, turning it into pure qi and blood, washing through the body.
